geometry_recipe: Reconstruct only the touched whole original12.0471792221m terrain cells with the current final corridor/water/property exclusions and the same constrained Delaunay recipe. Split each original emitted triangle at class boundaries. Heights, source UVs and normals interpolate barycentrically on those exact original faces. Do not sample new height vertices or normalize the interpolated normals, which would alter the original normal field. Retain the exact original plane and original boundary vertices. Register the completed(row,column) IDs in scene.emitted_terrain_cells so the final raw-grid loop skips only those cells. Do not add whole-cell geometry to terrain_cutouts or change the global GEOS union, which can flip unrelated grid-cell diagonals and move terrain by metres.
deferred_surface_guard: Before any emitted material or emitted-cell registration, fail if any selected cell overlaps a current verge_patches or ground_patches surface. This explicitly prevents removing shoulder or prior ground layers. The present private Monaco recipe has no overlapping deferred surfaces. Existing separately emitted venue surfaces remain excluded through their original terrain_cutouts.
